subject: Runtime / Infra: Request for 3-headcount slate + comp band proposal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime / Infra: Request for 3-headcount slate + comp band proposal

Hi team,

Following our capacity planning session, I'm proposing we open a small slate of hires for the Runtime/Platform squad to support Q3 throughput projects and latency SLOs. Summary: 

- Roles requested: 2 Senior Runtime Engineers (L4) + 1 Principal Platform Engineer (L5 lead-level IC)
- Rationale: sustained traffic growth (+45% YoY tail tokens), upcoming multi-region rollout, and long lead time for kernel-optimization hires
- Proposed comp bands (base + target equity, total comp ranges in attached PDF): L4: $180k–$240k TC, L5: $260k–$340k TC
- Expected incremental monthly burn (salary + benefits + bench): ~$75k/month starting on onboarding month
- Hiring timeline: post-approval we ask TA to open reqs by 5/17, first onsite by 6/21, offers by 7/15

Attachments: hc_slate_q3_2027.xlsx (roles + cost breakdown), comp-band-proposal-runtime.pdf (benchmarks vs market)

Ask: Please confirm headcount authorization and alignment on bands so Talent Ops can begin sourcing. Laura — can you confirm cost center and whether these should be routed through platform headcount bucket or infra reserved pool?

Thanks,
Connor
Sr. Manager, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime / Infra: Request for 3-headcount slate + comp band proposal

Connor — thanks for the clear packet. I reviewed the spreadsheet and the comp-band PDF. High level: I am provisionally supportive of the slate, but need two confirmations before moving to formal signoff:

1) Cost center alignment: these should come from Platform IC budget (PLFM-RT-2027). If we reassign to infra pool, we need a transfer and a justification memo for finance.
2) Equity/offer bands: comp committee requires that L4 median doesn't exceed current platform medians — please provide 3 recent offer comps (redacted) for L4 roles so we can validate market delta.

Markus — can you weigh in on the ask for a principal-level IC? Is that strictly required or could we promote a strong L4 with a lead responsibilities ramp?

If we get those two items today I can take it to Finance for a quick approval on the headcount slot.

—Laura
Director, Finance Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime / Infra: Request for 3-headcount slate + comp band proposal

On Tue, May 10, 2027 at 09:00, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Markus — can you weigh in on the ask for a principal-level IC? Is that strictly required or could we promote a strong L4 with a lead responsibilities ramp?

Short answer: we should keep the Principal slot. For the upcoming kernel work and multi-region routing changes we need ownership at the architecture level — a promoted L4 will take too long to ramp and we'll lose velocity. The principal will unblock both design + cross-org reviews (infra + serving + billing).

That said, I'm open to re-scoping the responsibilities to reduce comp expectations if needed: e.g., hire Principal as a 0.9 FTE lead with an expectation of owning one major milestone (kernel scheduling) in 9 months. That would let us target the lower end of the L5 band initially.

Connor, please include three recent L4 offer comps in a follow-up (redacted) and update the HC slate with the cost center code (PLFM-RT-2027). Once Laura confirms we can route to Evelyn for executive sign-off.

—Markus
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, talent-ops@hireflow.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Runtime / Infra: Request for 3-headcount slate + comp band proposal

Evelyn — forwarding the packet after Laura/Markus review. Key points for exec sign-off: 

- 3 FTEs requested: 2x L4 (senior runtime engineers), 1x L5 (principal platform engineer)
- Cost center: PLFM-RT-2027 (confirmed)
- Comp bands: L4 $180k–$240k TC, L5 $260k–$340k TC (we propose offers at lower quartile to start; comp committee will review sample L4 redacted offers attached)
- Expected incremental OPEX: ~$900k annual run-rate including benefits and equity targets (spreadsheet attached)
- Timeline: approvals this week enable TA to post reqs and aim for hires onboarded by mid-July

Attachments: hc_slate_q3_2027.xlsx, comp-band-proposal-runtime.pdf
Action requested: Evelyn we need your signature on the headcount authorization form (DocuSign link below) to convert the provisional slots into live reqs. If you prefer, I can present this for 5 minutes in tomorrow's leadership stand-up.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/hc-authorization-9876
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RtX-runtime-hc-q3

Thanks for the review — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Connor
Sr. Manager, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
